summary: Youlife Group Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K press release announcing that its subsidiary Jiangxi Youlan entered a strategic cooperation framework agreement with Ji'an Industry-Education Integration Technology Co. to develop a vocational education park. No securities transaction, tender offer, acquisition, divestiture, or corporate action affecting shareholders is involved. The agreement grants exclusive operating rights and includes a five-year initial term with renewal option. There are no deal terms, prices, or shareholder implications. This is a routine business development announcement, not a special-situation event.
